title: ABUS Numerino 5510C Combo Cable Lock Black, 180cm

comparisons.notes: Numero 5510C 180cm x 10mm black with SCMU mount; MFPN 16523, barcode 4003318165238; store product data shows in stock

writeup: The ABUS Numerino 5510C is a 180cm (about 6 ft) coiled steel cable lock, 10mm thick, with a resettable 4-digit combination and a frame mount included. Woot has it new for $9.99, while Boulder Nordic & Cycle Sport charges $32.99 for the same black 180cm lock (model 16523). Stock is very limited, with a limit of 3 per customer.
